meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 当主持人:把你选的 worktree、分支或 PR 各当一个 agent 拉进共享的 STANDUP.md 聊天室,分轮介绍改动、解决冲突,最后写汇总并用大白话给出目标分支与合并顺序。全程只读,不提交不合并。
howto.when: 当你要对多个 worktree、分支或 PR 做一次 standup——对比各自改动、理清怎么合并成一个时触发。候选只有 0 或 1 个时不算 standup,它会说明并让你放宽条件。

say.text: 这两个分支怎么合?开个 standup 讨论合并顺序。
say.note: 分轮发言后给出目标与合并顺序

say.text: 把 standup 的结论翻译成人话,再交给 /do 执行合并。
say.note: 你确认决定后由 /do 做实际合并

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: each worktree, branch or PR you pick joins a shared STANDUP.md room, resolves conflicts round by round, and writes a summary naming a target branch and merge order in plain language. Read-only; nothing merges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want a standup across several worktrees, branches or PRs — comparing their changes and how to consolidate them. With zero or one candidate it stops and offers to widen.

say_en.text: Start a standup with the worktrees touched in the last 24 hours.
say_en.note: It lists candidates for you to confirm.

say_en.text: How should these two branches merge? Run a standup on merge order.
say_en.note: Rounds end with a target and merge order.

say_en.text: Translate the standup outcome into plain language and hand it to /do.
say_en.note: You settle the open calls; /do merges.
